# What does a birthday party package really make? True profit, margin and the lowest price

> Free calculator for trampoline parks, bounce gyms, play cafes and family entertainment centers.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
